summary: Count all retained MP4 concat timing-table capacities, including unselected tracks, in controlled-memory admission
before: One regression failed: two segments with 2 selected packets and 512 unselected packets each were admitted under 40 KiB although both timing tables were retained. Generous-budget control passed.
after: Three focused tests pass: tight budget refusal, generous budget acceptance, four selected output packets decoded by owned AAC. Six related tests pass.
limitations: Checks the existing controlled-memory estimate against retained vector capacity; not a physical RSS limit. No performance claim.

remux_capacity_follow_up.after: Use retained capacity. Three focused and five related tests pass on combined source including concurrent metadata accounting; successful output has two packets and 2048 mono samples at 48 kHz.
